name: Karutsu no Madoujou Tactics
original_name: カルツの魔導城 タクティクス
source:
Long ago, on a distant continent, there was a small kingdom caught between powerful nations, a fragile realm struggling to survive.

The previous king had spent his life engaging in delicate diplomacy to keep the country safe. But after passing away from  an unexpected illness, he left behind only his young and inexperienced heir, Prince Hauro.

Sensing weakness, the neighboring nations marched in without hesitation, swallowing the castle town and its surroundings almost overnight.

Then, on a fateful day, Hauro performed a forbidden ritual and summoned the Flame Demon Calthufer. The spirit spoke to him:

“Swear yourself to me, and vow to burn this entire continent to the ground.
Do so, and I shall bestow upon you the power to topple enemy fortresses and lay their lands in ruin.”

[Translated from [url=http://beelzebub.sakura.ne.jp/calthu/]official website[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，在一个遥远的大陆上，有一个夹在强国之间的小王国，一个脆弱的王国，挣扎着生存。

前任国王一生都致力于微妙的外交，以确保国家的安全。但在一场意外的疾病去世后，他只留下了年轻且缺乏经验的继承人豪罗王子。

察觉到自己的弱点，邻国毫不犹豫地进军，几乎在一夜之间吞没了城下町及其周边地区。

然后，在决定性的一天，豪罗进行了禁忌仪式并召唤了炎魔卡尔瑟弗。灵魂对他说话：

“向我发誓，发誓要将整个大陆烧毁。
这样做，我就会赐予你力量，摧毁敌人的堡垒，摧毁他们的土地。”

[翻译自[url=http://beelzebub.sakura.ne.jp/calthu/]官网[/url]]
